lines.text: When I became pregnant with my first child in 2020, the most repeated
advice I got in Hong Kong was to line up a confinement nanny. But no
one could tell me where and how to find them. After scouting online
forums, Facebook groups and asking around, I got a dozen Whatsapp
contacts. But all of them were either unavailable or unsuitable.
I ended up paying 6000HKD more to hire through an agency. As I went
on my journey as a first time mom, whenever I needed to hire
postpartum help, I found the process of getting help still relied heavily
on word of mouth. I thought, why isn't there a platform where new
parents can easily be connected to the postnatal help they need?
Parachute was born out of necessity. We are starting with the elusive
confinement nannies community, with a mission to make postnatal
help more accessible and transparent than ever.
From Rosalind Bei, Founder of Parachute
Hong Kong Employment Agency Licence Number. 72216
